latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Instant Client Audit Report Generator — automate deep-dive prospect audits to close more agency deals, powered by Apify and Claude AI.

- Instantly generates comprehensive audit reports for any prospect domain, covering website UX, SEO, ads, reviews, social media, tech stack, and competitors.
- Integrates multiple Apify actors for detailed data extraction: website crawling, SEO audit, ad intelligence, review scraping, social media analysis, and tech stack detection.
- Produces a structured, ready-to-send report featuring scores, diagnostics, critical issues, quick wins, competitor benchmarks, and a personalized agency pitch.
- Fully customizable inputs, including agency details and competitor domains; outputs in JSON/Markdown, PDF-ready format.
- Designed to maximize client acquisition by sending actionable insights before your first meeting.
